title: Consider Digital Crown data inspection

statement.en: Consider using the Digital Crown to inspect data when navigation isn't needed.
statement.ja: navigationが不要なときDigital Crownでdataをinspectすることを検討する。

conditions: The Digital Crown doesn't need to navigate lists or pages.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Digital Crown experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDigital Crownの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

statement.ja: すべてのDigital Crown interactionにvisual feedbackを提供する。

title: Use default Digital Crown haptics when appropriate

statement.en: Use default Digital Crown haptic feedback when it fits the watchOS experience.
statement.ja: watchOS experienceに合う場合はdefault Digital Crown haptic feedbackを使う。

conditions: Turn off detents when they don't fit the app or its animation.
exceptions: Tables may use linear instead of row-based detents for differently sized rows.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Digital Crown experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDigital Crownの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Anchor watchOS navigation to the Digital Crown

statement.en: Use the Digital Crown as the primary anchor for watchOS app navigation.
statement.ja: watchOS app navigationのprimary anchorとしてDigital Crownを使う。

conditions: Use vertically oriented lists, tabs, and scroll views for important interface elements.
exceptions: Digital Crown presses remain reserved for system functionality.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Digital Crown experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
